title: 巨型冰滑梯与驯鹿的蓝眼睛
pdf: https://michael-podcast-1513696684.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/vol30/Vol30_晚读讲义_巨型冰滑梯与驯鹿的蓝眼睛_v2.pdf
pdfName: Vol30_晚读讲义_巨型冰滑梯与驯鹿的蓝眼睛_v2.pdf

blocks.en: Hello, young explorers, and welcome back to Michael's Morning Listening! Today we visit two frozen worlds: a giant ice slide, and a reindeer whose eyes change color with the seasons. Put on your warm coat. Let's go!
blocks.title: 开场白
blocks.cn: 你好，小小探险家们，欢迎回到 Michael 的早听晚读！今天我们要去两个冰天雪地的地方：一条巨型冰滑梯，和一只眼睛会随季节变色的驯鹿。穿上你最暖和的外套。出发吧！

blocks.en: In Harbin, a city in the far north of China, winter builds a whole park out of ice and snow. It is the largest ice and snow park in the world, filled with more than a thousand artworks made of ice and snow. Inside it stands a super ice slide, 521 meters long — longer than five football fields!
blocks.title: 巨型冰滑梯
blocks.cn: 在中国最北边的城市哈尔滨，冬天用冰雪建起了一整座乐园。它是世界上最大的冰雪乐园，里面有一千多件冰雪艺术品。乐园里立着一条超级冰滑梯，长 521 米——比五个足球场连起来还长！

blocks.en: Workers cut huge blocks of ice from a frozen river. The ice comes in every format: castles, towers, glowing lanterns, and one very long slide. Twenty-four lanes run side by side, so families can race together. The caption under one photo says it all: "The fastest way to feel like flying."
blocks.title: 巨型冰滑梯
blocks.cn: 工人们从结冰的河里切下巨大的冰块。冰以各种形式出现：城堡、高塔、发光的灯笼，还有一条很长很长的滑梯。二十四条滑道并排而行，一家人可以一起比赛。有一张照片下面的说明写得最到位：“感受飞翔最快的方式。”

blocks.en: Outside the park, pedestrians walk past ice houses and bridges, all lit up like a dream. Children climb to the top in thick coats, sit on a soft mat, and push off. A fine spray of ice crystals flies up behind them. They laugh all the way down, deaf to the cold wind. At the bottom, the crowd erupts in cheers, and everyone climbs up to go again. With patience, the workers rebuild the park every winter — and every winter the fun comes back with the snow.
blocks.title: 巨型冰滑梯
blocks.cn: 乐园外面，行人走过用冰做的房子和桥，灯光照着，像梦一样。孩子们穿着厚外套爬到滑梯顶上，坐在软垫子上，用力一蹬。细细的冰晶水花在身后飞起来。他们一路笑着滑下去，根本听不见寒风。滑到底，大家爆发出一阵欢呼，又都爬上去再滑一次。工人们凭着耐心，每年冬天都把乐园重新建起来——每年冬天，快乐也都跟着雪一起回来。

blocks.en: Now fly far to the north, past the Arctic Circle, where winter nights last for weeks. Reindeer live there, and they must find food and spot wolves in very dim light. Their secret is in their eyes.
blocks.title: 驯鹿的蓝眼睛
blocks.cn: 现在飞到更北的地方，越过北极圈，那里的冬夜会持续好几个星期。驯鹿就住在那里，它们必须在很暗的光线下找到食物、发现狼群。它们的秘密藏在眼睛里。

blocks.en: Behind the retina, the part of the eye that catches light, reindeer have a mirror-like layer called the tapetum lucidum. In summer, this mirror looks golden. But in winter, it turns a vivid blue. Why? In the long darkness, the reindeer's pupils stay wide open, and the pressure inside the eye rises. The tiny fibers in the mirror pack closer together, and it starts to reflect blue light instead of gold.
blocks.title: 驯鹿的蓝眼睛
blocks.cn: 在视网膜后面——视网膜就是眼睛里捕捉光线的部分——驯鹿有一层像镜子一样的组织，叫明毯。在夏天，这面镜子是金色的。可到了冬天，它会变成鲜艳的蓝色。为什么呢？在漫长的黑暗里，驯鹿的瞳孔一直张得大大的，眼睛里的压力升高了。镜子里的细小纤维挤得更紧了，它就开始反射蓝光，而不是金光。

blocks.en: Blue is the color of Arctic twilight — the soft blue light that fills the sky for hours each day. With blue eyes, reindeer can see much better in that dim light. They can spot a wolf moving against the snow, and find the pale lichen they love, hidden under the snow. Nature makes no discrimination: every animal must find its own way through winter, and the reindeer found a beautiful one.
blocks.title: 驯鹿的蓝眼睛
blocks.cn: 蓝色是北极暮光的颜色——那种柔和的蓝光每天会在天空中停留好几个小时。有了蓝眼睛，驯鹿在昏暗的光线下能看得清楚多了。它们能发现雪地上移动的狼，还能找到藏在雪下的、它们爱吃的淡色地衣。大自然不偏袒谁：每种动物都得找到自己的办法熬过冬天，而驯鹿找到了一个很美的办法。

blocks.en: The reindeer is like an ambassador for all Arctic animals: a small change inside the body can make a big difference. And when summer returns, the mirror turns golden again.
blocks.title: 驯鹿的蓝眼睛
blocks.cn: 驯鹿就像是所有北极动物的代言人：身体里一个小小的变化，就能带来大大的不同。等夏天回来，镜子又会变回金色。

blocks.en: Here's today's idiom: 'on cloud nine.' When you feel so happy that you feel like floating high in the sky, you are on cloud nine! Here's an example: 'After she raced down the giant ice slide, Mia was on cloud nine all the way home.' When were you last on cloud nine?
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 今天的俚语是“on cloud nine”（飘飘然，高兴得像在第九朵云上）。当你高兴得觉得自己像飘在高高的天上时，你就是 on cloud nine！举个例子：“米娅从巨型冰滑梯上飞驰而下后，一路回家都飘飘然的。”你上一次飘飘然是什么时候？

blocks.en: Let's think about our stories. The ice slide is 521 meters long, and a reindeer's eyes turn blue in winter. Two questions for you. First: if you could build anything out of ice, what would you build — a castle, a slide, or something nobody has ever seen? Second: if your eyes could change color with the seasons, which colors would you choose? Talk about it with your family!
blocks.title: 结束语与互动问题
blocks.cn: 我们来想想今天的故事。冰滑梯长 521 米，驯鹿的眼睛冬天会变蓝。问你们两个问题。第一：如果你能用冰造任何东西，你会造什么——城堡、滑梯，还是从来没有人见过的东西？第二：如果你的眼睛能随季节变颜色，你会选哪些颜色？和家人聊聊吧！

blocks.en: That's all for today, young explorers. Be brave like a slider on the giant slide, and bright-eyed like a reindeer. And remember: when you feel on cloud nine, enjoy it! See you tomorrow!
blocks.title: 告别
blocks.cn: 今天的节目就到这里啦，小小探险家们。像巨型滑梯上的滑行者一样勇敢，像驯鹿一样目光明亮。还要记住：当你觉得飘飘然的时候，好好享受它！明天见！

quiz.title: B. 单项选择（Single Choice）
questions:
How long is the super ice slide in Harbin?
A. 24 meters
B. 121 meters
C. 521 meters
D. 1,000 meters

What happens to a reindeer's tapetum lucidum in winter?
A. It turns golden
B. It turns vivid blue
C. It disappears
D. It turns red

What does "on cloud nine" mean?
A. Feeling very sad
B. Feeling very happy, like floating in the sky
C. Sleeping on a cloud
D. Flying on a plane

Why can reindeer see better in dim winter light?
A. Their eyes grow bigger
B. Their blue mirror reflects blue twilight light
C. They sleep all winter
D. They wear special glasses

children.text: , the part of the eye that catches light, reindeer have a
：Behind（在……后面）+ 名词，放在句首，先告诉你“在哪里”——在视网膜后面。英语里这种地点状语可以前置，让句子先有画面感，再出主角。
the part of the eye that catches light
：that catches light 修饰 part（部分），告诉你是哪一部分——就是“捕捉光线的那一部分”。that 在从句里作主语，后面直接跟动词 catches，不加人称代词。
过去分词短语作后置定语
：called（被称作）+ 名称，紧跟在 layer（层）后面，说明这层叫什么。相当于 "which is called the tapetum lucidum" 的缩写，英语里常用这种分词短语省掉 which is。
位置（视网膜后）→ 同位说明（眼睛里捕捉光线的部分）→ 主体（驯鹿有一层像镜子一样的东西）→ 名称（明毯）
。一句话里藏着介词短语、定语从句和分词定语三个机关。
. The text says the slide is
"521 meters long — longer than five football fields!"
"In winter, it turns a vivid blue."
"When you feel so happy that you feel like floating high in the sky, you are on cloud nine!"
"can see much better in that dim light."
D. Your own translations — there is no key for this part. Read your Chinese aloud and check that it sounds natural.
